ada.text: Good morning, everyone! I'm Ada, and I keep bees, so my morning began with a wave to the sunrise on the green. Then I rested on the bench by the cottage, and later I took a lovely swim in the pond before walking here. A calm, bright morning, and I'm glad to share it with you.

bo.text: I spent the morning mostly on my own, wandering from the green out to the orchard and back again. It was quiet, so I hummed a little tune as I walked. Mornings like this are my favourite, because nobody minds if I say very little.
